sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; selected the memory-injection paper after excluding recent FORGE, Direct-OPD, CompactionRL, LLM-as-a-Verifier, Agent Data Injection, CXI, and Doomed from the Start topics.

Read arXiv metadata, PDF, and HTML full text; extracted threat model, WhisperBench construction, MemGhost proxies, reward design, SFT/RL training, results, defenses, limitations, and related-work boundaries.
Markdown uses self-contained TLDR, h3 sections, tables, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, figure/table evidence interpretation, and more than 5000 Chinese characters.
